item.title: Release: Kristala
item.description:
Kristala is a dark fantasy ARPG with challenging combat, fluid parkour, and deep exploration – and it's now available on GOG!

Unleash your arcane power and step into the role of a feline warrior destined to uncover the source of a deadly curse threatening your world. Avoid damage by blocking, dodging, and deflecting attacks.

Now on GOG!

item.title: Early Access: The Citadel Project
item.description:
The Citadel Project is  a solo-developed stealth game with lite RPG/adventure elements – and it's now available in early access on GOG!

Set in a Dark Fantasy environment, you are at a disadvantage in direct combat and have no magic spells to back you up... Use stealth, assassination, and many tools at your disposal to survive and avoid danger. The Citadel Project, the last line of defense built by the Ancient Kings in an attempt to preserve what remains of humanity in the face of the Great Storm.

Now on GOG!

item.title: Release: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead
item.description:
A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead is a single-player horror adventure game – and it's now available on GOG!

Inspired by the critically acclaimed blockbuster movie franchise that highlights a unique survivor story after an invasion of deadly creatures. In this exclusive spin-off, experience the journey of a young woman who must endure a treacherous apocalypse in the midst of interpersonal family conflicts, all while coming to terms with her own inner fears.

Now on GOG!
